title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About Teachable:

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.


At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management: you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.


As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.


In this role you’ll:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.
  • Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.
  • Drive product adoption by connecting Teachable’s features and tools to concrete business use cases, helping creators understand what to adopt, when to adopt it, and how it supports their growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.


Must haves:

  • 4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
  • Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
  • Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
  • Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
  • Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
  • Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
  • Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
  • Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or SaaS businesses
  • Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagement


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Enjoy a proactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
  • Prefer working with autonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooks


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Customer Operations Specialist
description:
Summary


Sphere is revolutionizing global money movement by building modern financial rails with digital dollars, making transactions simple, affordable, and accessible worldwide. Through our frontend applications, APIs, low-level bank messaging optimizations, and liquidity infrastructure, businesses in emerging markets can send money across borders at scale — without depending on foreign capital or simply speaking the right languages. We combine frontier technology like stablecoins and zero-knowledge proofs with traditional banking, payments, and foreign exchange infrastructure to make global payments settle in minutes.


We’re a Seed+ startup globally distributed across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Portugal, and the Caribbean. We’ve processed over $1B in payments volume and are backed by some of the best high-frequency trading and venture firms in the world, including TCG, Jump, Hudson River Trading, and Coinbase; as well as angels from companies like Stripe, PayPal, Brex, Visa, Revolut, Grab, Solana, Circle, and JPMorgan Chase. Our team has previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world’s leading companies (Coinbase, Vanguard, Franklin Templeton, Chainalysis, Wells Fargo) as well as at startups and accelerators like YCombinator. We’re spending the best years of our lives building Sphere, driven by a shared belief in our mission to enhance human prosperity through cutting-edge technology, creating a modern SWIFT for the 21st century and beyond.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage the onboarding lifecycle of our enterprise customers, serving as their key liaison and ensuring timely setup
  • Support customers in navigating our Anti-Money Laundering requirements, including Know-Your-Customer and enhanced due diligence checks
  • Drive post-setup customer success with our enterprise customers, helping them unlock the full value of our offerings
  • Build out and manage a robust, multi-channel customer support function (email, chat), to deliver quick and effective resolutions to customer inquiries
  • Work closely with Sales & Product teams to transition customers to new product offerings or vendors
  • Proactively gather and synthesize customer needs and feedback, identifying opportunities for product/UX improvements


Requirements


  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and either Spanish or Portuguese
  • Excels at multi-tasking and rapid context switching in fast-paced environments
  • Demonstrated sense of ownership and strong project management & Organizational skills
  • Analytical, with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills


Nice to haves


  • Prior experience in a customer success, customer onboarding or customer-facing role
  • Prior experience in Compliance, Payments or Web3
  • Knowledge of SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, wire transfers, and other global payment networks.
  • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) processes, currency conversions, and multi-currency settlement
  • Open to working flexible hours, and extended shifts, to meet business needs


Why Join Us?


  • After years navigating the idea maze, we’ve stumbled on a previously unexplored path to exponentially boost human prosperity and make the world a fairer place. Join us in making a global impact, particularly in emerging regions that are just starting to connect.
  • Have executive level impact, responsibility, and upside in an early-stage startup that has found initial product-market fit and has been growing more than 100% per month over the last year.
  • Work on some of the hardest problems in the world, leveraging frontier technology in cryptography and distributed systems to modernize payments infrastructure from 1959.
  • Unlock exceptional growth and learning opportunities in an environment that champions ownership, ambition, and innovation.
  • Join as an early employee and help us define a world-class culture of collaboration, rationality, low ego/status, customer obsession, and output. There are rare learning opportunities, and you’ll be joining just as we start to scale.

title: PMO TI Trilingue \"#988548\"

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como PMO do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento de cronograma, escopo, orçamento e qualidade.
  • Coordenar reuniões de status, comitês de projeto e comunicação entre times locais e globais.
  • Gerenciar riscos, dependências e planos de mitigação.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos legais e operacionais dos países envolvidos.

  • Consolidar e reportar indicadores de progresso e entregas.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre áreas de negócio e equipes técnicas (TI, integração, segurança da informação).

Recursos que o PMO deverá coordenar:

  • Equipes locais de RH e Payroll nos três países.
  • Parceiros de tecnologia (implementadores do sistema).
  • Fornecedores de folha locais (caso haja integração ou transição).
  • Time global de tecnologia e compliance.
  • Equipes técnicas de TI (infraestrutura, integração, segurança da informação).
  • Stakeholders internos (Finanças, Jurídico, TI, etc.).

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de sistemas de folha de pagamento.
  • Fluência em espanhol e inglês (ambos obrigatórios); português será considerado diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de folha – Workday será considerado um diferencial importante.
  • Conhecimento dos processos de folha de pagamento em Peru, Colômbia e/ou Equador.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação de sistemas, com entendimento de arquitetura de integração, interfaces, ETL, e segurança de dados.
  • Capacidade de interagir com equipes técnicas de TI para definição de requisitos, validação de integrações e acompanhamento de testes.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, PMBOK, etc.).
  • Habilidade de trabalhar com equipes multiculturais e distribuídas.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais aos países envolvidos (Peru, Colômbia e Equador).

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office, com viagens pontuais nos países Peru, Colômbia e Equador.

title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.

title: Senior Back-End Engineer (PHP, Node.js, OR Python)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouse, and embedded analytics ecosystem.

This role acts as the bridge between the application stack and the data platform, ensuring that analytics, reporting, and automation capabilities are seamlessly exposed to both internal systems and customer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer experienced with modern frameworks (PHP, Node.js, or Python), API design, multi-tenant authentication (Auth0/SSO), and data service abstractions. They combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep appreciation for performance, security, and maintainability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs that expose warehouse and reporting data to SaaS applications and third-party systems
  • Develop scalable, tenant-aware service layers that abstract complex Redshift or Snowflake queries behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build secure integrations between the SaaS application and analytics systems (QuickSight embedding, SSO/role propagation, etc.)
  • Ensure multi-tenant context propagation and data isolation across all API endpoints
  • Work with the Data Platform and Analytics teams to define reusable data-access abstractions
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design backend patterns supporting large-scale, automated reporting workloads
  • Implement caching, pagination, and batching strategies for high-volume, concurrent
  • analytics requests
  • Monitor API latency and database query efficiency, applying indexing and optimization
  • where necessary
  • Contribute to system design documentation, endpoint versioning, and architecture diagrams
  • Integrate SSO and identity management (Auth0, Cognito, or OIDC) into all service endpoints
  • Enforce least-privilege data access and row-level security (RLS) through token or role propagation
  • Ensure compliance with PII and data governance policies, encryption standards, and audit logging
  • Collaborate with InfoSec and Compliance teams to perform code reviews and security assessments
  • Work with DevOps to deploy and scale backend services via Docker, ECS, or EKS pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD automation for service deployment, schema migrations, and integration tests
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code definitions (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability and monitoring via CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Platform teams to ensure APIs align with data contracts and warehouse schemas
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to define API requirements and roadmap priorities
  • Participate in technical design reviews, security audits, and postmortems
  • Continuously improve service performance, reliability, and developer experience


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in a modern web stack
  • Proficiency in PHP (Laminas, Symfony, Laravel), Node.js, or Python for backend service development
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs at scale
  • Hands-on experience integrating data warehouse APIs (Redshift, Snowflake) or analytics services (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Solid understanding of multi-tenant authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect)
  • Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudFormation
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data-access patterns, including query optimization and caching
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and API observability


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some type of technical engineering
  • Experience with embedded analytics frameworks (AWS QuickSight Embedding SDK, Looker Embed, etc.)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation)
  • Knowledge of GraphQL federation, caching layers (Redis), and event-driven designs
  • Experience in data-driven SaaS products (hospitality, property management, or fintech a plus)
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and API auditing practices


Additional Information

  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.


⸻


The Role


As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.


You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.


This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.


⸻


Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.


⸻


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.


⸻


Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.


⸻


Why Join Vendry


Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.


  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP , com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Oracle Cloud (OCI).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. title: Senior Graphic Designer (Figma, Marketing & Paid Social)
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Graphic Designer who works daily in Figma and designs high-converting landing pages, emails, and paid social ads for e-commerce brands.


Job Title: Senior Graphic Designer (Figma, Landing Pages, Email & Performance Ads)

Company: Sender Agency

Location: Remote (LATAM preferred, East Coast or Central Time overlap)

Type: Full-Time, Monday to Friday

Compensation: $1,600 to $2,500 USD per month


We’re hiring a Senior Graphic Designer who works daily in Figma and designs high-converting landing pages, emails, and paid social ads for e-commerce brands.


This role is performance-focused. You will design assets that drive clicks, conversions, and revenue across the funnel.


If you have strong taste and understand how design impacts CRO, this role is for you.

About Sender Agency


Sender Agency is a performance-focused creative agency that has spent the last seven years building and scaling e-commerce brands. We have worked with blue-chip and celebrity-backed companies including Cacti by Travis Scott, Just Water by Will Smith, Alice Mushrooms, and brands backed by Patrick Mahomes.


Our team has launched brands from zero and helped scale existing businesses past $20M in revenue. Design plays a central role in that growth. We care about how things look, but more importantly, we care about how they perform.


The Role

We are hiring a Senior Graphic Designer to own landing page design, email design, and paid advertising creative using Figma.


This is a hands-on role for a designer who understands that strong visuals support conversion and that landing pages, emails, and ads must work together as a system.


You will work closely with the founders, media buyers, and copywriters to produce creative that is visually strong, conversion-focused, and built to scale.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing conversion-focused landing pages in Figma for e-commerce brands
  • Creating email designs for Klaviyo, including flows and campaigns
  • Producing high-volume paid social ad creative for Meta and other platforms
  • Maintaining visual consistency across ads, emails, and landing pages
  • Iterating quickly using templates, systems, and AI-assisted workflows
  • Using AI tools for image generation and rapid creative iteration
  • Collaborating with founders, media buyers, and copywriters
  • Improving creative based on performance feedback such as CTR, thumb-stop rate, and conversion rate

Who You Are

  • A senior-level graphic designer with strong taste and performance instincts
  • Highly proficient in Figma, especially for landing pages and email systems
  • Experienced with conversion-focused design and CRO principles
  • Comfortable producing a high volume of work without sacrificing quality
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own workload
  • Clear and professional in written and spoken English


Bonus experience: familiarity with AI-driven creative workflows, basic copywriting instincts, and understanding of Meta ad performance metrics


Why You’ll Like Working Here


Sender Agency operates with a flat team structure. Strong ideas are encouraged regardless of role or title. You will work directly with the founders and be trusted to take ownership of your work.

We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and follow through. This is a results-driven environment with a strong creative culture and high standards.


About the Founders

Richard – Worked on the global marketing team at Levi’s and led creative and content at Chubbies. Background in brand and storytelling at a high level.

Alan – Career in VC-backed media and tech companies. Has helped build, scale, and exit multiple businesses.


Together, they bring a balance of brand thinking and performance execution.


Role Details

  • Full-time, Monday through Friday
  • Working hours aligned with East Coast or Central Time
  • Fully remote, with preference for candidates based in Latin America
  • Long-term role with real ownership


Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid test task to ensure alignment on quality, speed, and performance thinking.



Final Note


This role is demanding, but it offers real ownership and meaningful impact. You will not just be designing assets. You will be contributing directly to how brands grow and perform.

If you are a senior designer who cares about results and wants to work closely with a high-caliber team, we would like to hear from you.


— Richard Tubman

  • Sender Agency

title: Network Engineer
description:
Job Title: Network Engineer

Location: Brazil - Remote

Duration : 12+ Months

Job Description


Design, configure, and maintain Cisco network and security appliances and hardware, including Catalyst switches, ISR routers, FirePower, FMC, WLC, ISE, DNA, SD-WAN management, and troubleshooting.

  • Deep knowledge on WAN/LAN networking, including wireless, fiber-optic and copper cable.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot network performance to ensure minimal downtime and resilience to potential cybersecurity threats.
  • Validate configuration backup systems are up and running.
  • Manage IT-Network support tickets and monitor ticket queues.
  • Implement security protocols such as firewalls, access controls, and encryption.
  • Document network configurations and update system documentation regularly including visio diagrams.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to optimize network architecture for scalability.
  • Perform hardware and software system upgrades, patches, and maintenance.
  • Prepare detailed diagrams, use cases, instructional, and test documentation and guides.
  • Coordinate with reporting manager, user functional communities, and team members on task priorities and initiatives.
  • Conduct meetings, user training sessions, and testing with internal and external clients.
  • Stay current with the latest network and security trends, technologies, and industry best practices.

Core Competencies

  • Highly motivated and with strong attention to detail
  • Hands-on, problem-solving approach to managing and troubleshooting complex technical environments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Results-oriented, critical thinker, and with excellent planning and organizational skills
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with the ability to collaborate and interact with internal and external clients
  • Flexible and adaptable to change
  • Proactive, addressing potential problems before they occur

Requirements:

  • Hand-on experience on Cisco routers, switches, wireless, network operating systems including network appliances like FTD, ISE, DNAC, and SD-WAN.
  • Complete understanding on TCP/IP, OSI model and network protocols like SNMP, NetFlow, Syslog, DHCP, DNS, FTP, etc.
  • Must understand when to escalate urgent issues to the team.
  • Require a solid understanding of networking and troubleshooting.
  • Must be able to work occasionally after hours or weekends as required.
  • Work as part of a team as well as independently.
  • Available to be on-call for support.
  • Ability to work in a fast pace and dynamic environment.

Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to perform responsibilities in English.
  • Strong communication skills – verbal and written.
  • Minimum 7 years of Network Administration experience.
  • Ability to resolve and/or escalate issues in a timely fashion.
  • Strong experience in performing a variety of activities related to the analysis, installation, and troubleshooting of networking and applications.

title: AI Creative Operator (Paid ads)
description:
Role Summary

We are hiring an AI Creative Operator to produce high performing short form video ads using AI tools only.

This is a hands on execution role focused on speed, volume, and performance. You will not be responsible for strategy, branding, or long term planning. Your job is to generate, edit, and ship large volumes of ad creatives that are tested and judged purely by results.

If you enjoy building fast, iterating constantly, and letting data decide what wins, this role is for you.


What You Will Do

  • Create short form video ads for TikTok and Meta using AI tools only
  • Generate high volumes of hooks, variants, and edits daily
  • Recreate and remix winning competitor ads using provided references
  • Use tools like VEED, CapCut, HeyGen, and similar AI video tools
  • Follow clear SOPs and creative constraints
  • Ship work fast and improve based on performance feedback
  • Kill underperforming creatives quickly without attachment


What You Will Not Do

  • You will not define marketing strategy
  • You will not manage ad accounts or budgets
  • You will not appear on camera
  • You will not do brand storytelling or long form creative work
  • You will not guess what works without testing


Tools You Will Use

  • AI video editors such as VEED, CapCut, HeyGen
  • Ad inspiration tools such as Foreplay
  • Internal creative briefs and SOPs
  • Performance dashboards for feedback

Experience with these tools is a plus, but the ability to learn fast matters more.


Who This Role Is For

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Are highly comfortable using modern AI tools
  • Understand TikTok and short form video pacing
  • Can produce many versions of the same idea quickly
  • Do not get emotionally attached to your work
  • Prefer clear instructions and performance based feedback
  • Enjoy repetitive execution with constant improvement

You do not need years of marketing experience. Skill and output matter more than background.


Who This Role Is Not For

This role is not a fit if you:

  • Want to own strategy or creative direction
  • Prefer polished brand work over performance ads
  • Dislike rapid iteration and frequent kills
  • Need constant validation or subjective feedback
  • Want a traditional marketing career path


Success Metrics

You will be evaluated on:

  • Number of creatives shipped per week
  • Speed of iteration
  • Percentage of creatives that pass initial testing
  • Cost per install performance versus baseline

Opinions do not matter. Results do.


Location

Remote. We welcome applicants globally.

This role is fully async with clear processes and expectations.


How to Apply

Applicants will be asked to complete a short practical task that simulates the real work. Only candidates who demonstrate speed, taste, and execution ability will move forward.


To begin, complete this short work style assessment, we will select and message the best fit candidates:

Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore. Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.

A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.

Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de Manutenção?

Pré-requisitos:

· Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Naval, Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica;

· Inglês avançado;

· Conhecimento e experiência em Gestão de Pessoas.

Responsabilidades:

· Colaborar na definição de estratégias da área de PPCM (Planejamento, Programação e Controle de Manutenção) alinhadas a necessidade da empresa.

· Aplicar ferramentas de controle e monitoramento das manutenções das embarcações, buscando mitigar os riscos e promovendo a confiabilidade e segurança operacional.

· Garantir que as atividades de manutenção estejam programadas de acordo com as prioridades operacionais.

· Responder auditorias externas da embarcação.

· Emitir e analisar relatórios de causa raiz de acordo com os dados levantados com o Coordenador de Manutenção (executar RCA).

· Gerenciar eventos de downtime com atualização periódica para a alta gestão).

· Revisar e aprovar o planejamento de manutenção das grandes paradas realizadas pelo Coordenador de Manutenção.

· Monitorar e controlar os projetos de melhorias das suas embarcações.

· Liderar e avaliar o desempenho dos Coordenadores de Manutenção.

Benefícios BRAM Offshore:

· Plano de saúde e odontológico, extensivo aos dependentes;

· Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

· Vale transporte;

· Plataforma de cursos online para todos os colaboradores;

· Plataforma para apoiar no cuidado da saúde mental;

· Previdência Privada;

description:

Siga nossa página aqui no LinkedIn e fique por dentro de nossas oportunidades de carreira.

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!

O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou estacionamento conveniado;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Gympass e Totalpass;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Profissional;
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.

No seu dia-a-dia :

  • Atuar nas atividades de pequena, média e alta complexidade para prospectar profissionais médicos, clinicas, através de visitas, apresentando vantagens e propostas de atração, visando o credenciamento para atendimento aos clientes, e aumento da utilização da rede credenciada;
  • Realizar a prospecção, implantação, manutenção e expansão da rede credenciada, analisando custos e garantindo a qualidade do serviço prestado, atuando com autonomia;
  • Descrever o processo de credenciamento de prestadores de serviço de atenção domiciliar, Retaguarda e Atenção Primária à Saúde, bem como elaborar relatórios e demonstrativos diversos da área, levantar e compilar dados, calcular e apurar valores, preenchendo
  • planilhas, visando disponibilizar informações gerenciais para a análise e tomada de decisão. Negociar com os novos credenciamentos a aplicação e padronização e referente as tabelas utilizadas pela companhia;
  • Realizar reuniões com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar para a análise de contratos, reajustes, aditivos de contratos, prestar suporte aos prestadores implantados, bem como orientar os novos prestadores sobre a rotina de faturamento, encaminhamentos e autorizações da operadora;
  • Monitorar o atendimento das cláusulas contratuais e índices da Agência Nacional da Saúde (ANS), através de reuniões para renegociações de reajustes e readequação de contratos;
  • Atender solicitações das Unimeds, direcionar as demandas às áreas pertinentes quando necessário, acompanhar e finalizar as resoluções;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as informações referentes ao negócio, bem como sobre projetos de expansão, legislação, concorrentes, clientes (operadora, médicos, clinicas, operadoras, etc.) e novas oportunidades;
  • Elaborar simulações de impacto financeiro com base nas solicitações de reajuste das Unimeds para renovação contratual;
  • Assessorar a Diretoria, a Superintendência, a Gerência nas demandas de relacionamento com
  • as Unimeds (custos, indicadores, reuniões). Parametrizar sistema interno com as regras contratuais e tabelas de pagamentos negociadas;
  • Manter constante contato com a área comercial, visando conhecer os novos negócios e ampliação dos atuais contratos, atuando proativamente na ampliação da rede de
  • credenciamento;
  • Pesquisar a abertura de novas unidades aos clientes, e/ou novos contratos em andamento e providenciar a rede credenciada necessária para atendimento, bem como manter a interface com a área de credenciamento para auxiliar no processo do credenciamento, e envio da documentação para credenciamento dos prestadores;
  • Verificar e analisar as cidades e municípios circunvizinhos, verificando a capacidade e disponibilidade de credenciamentos, visando o atendimento aos clientes e expansão nos negócios, e a partir desta análise elaborar credenciamento com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar.

Esperamos de você :

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Pacote office intermédiário;
  • Experiência com credenciamento de rede ambulatorial;

Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ;
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.

A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

We are Seeking a "Data Engineer" to build, optimize, and maintain the modern data platform within a cloud environment.

  • Deep knowledge of GCP cloud environments and data-related services.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with both relational and non-relational databases.
  • Experience with data streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka or managed cloud services.

title: Secretária
description:
SECRETÁRIA CRC | CLÍNICA ODONTOLÓGICA SORRISOS

REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS: EXPERIÊNCIA EM CLÍNICA MÉDICA OU ODONTOLÓGICA + RESIDIR NOS BAIRROS ESPECÍFICOS MENCIONADOS ABAIXO

QUEM SOMOS:

Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Nossos valores fundamentais de honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e qualidade guiam cada atendimento e procedimento que realizamos. Somos movidos pela missão de proporcionar saúde bucal de forma ética, humana e responsável, criando experiências únicas para nossos pacientes.

NOSSA VISÃO

Ser uma clínica referência em odontologia de excelência, proporcionando qualidade de vida e saúde bucal através de uma experiência única para nossos clientes. Aqui, cada paciente que chega com traumas e frustrações de experiências anteriores encontra acolhimento, profissionalismo e resultados transformadores.

A OPORTUNIDADE

Buscamos uma Secretária para nossa Central de Relacionamento com o Cliente (CRC) que compartilhe nossa paixão por transformar vidas e seja o primeiro sorriso acolhedor que nossos pacientes encontram ao chegar à clínica.

REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS:

• Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas • Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) • Disponibilidade para início imediato

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Primeiro Contato: Ser a voz e o rosto acolhedor da nossa clínica, recebendo pacientes com empatia e alegria • Gestão de Agenda: Organizar e otimizar os horários dos profissionais, confirmando consultas e evitando faltas • Comunicação Efetiva: Orientar pacientes sobre tratamentos e procedimentos com clareza e segurança • Organização Impecável: Manter prontuários, documentos e sistema atualizados para garantir processos eficientes • Suporte Administrativo: Auxiliar na parte administrativa da clínica, contribuindo para o fluxo de trabalho otimizado

O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas • Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas • Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade • Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office • Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade

POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓS?

• Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas • Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão • Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

• Regime de Contratação: CLT • Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE.RJ • Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial e sábado de 09 às 13:00h

. Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + comissão e benefícios

COMO SE CANDIDATAR

Envie seu currículo para com o assunto "Secretária CRC - SORRISOS", destacando seu bairro de residência logo no início do e-mail.

IMPORTANTE: Currículos sem a informação do bairro de residência ou de candidatas residentes fora das áreas mencionadas não serão avaliados.

Se você acredita no poder de um sorriso para transformar vidas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha com propósito, queremos conhecer você!

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.
You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.
Qualifications
Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
Some experience with MPI programming.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:
Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.
Responsabilidades:
Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio
Exigências do Cargo:
Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;
Escolaridade mínima:
Ensino médio técnico completo
Qualificação A: antes do embarque:
Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
Well Control IWCF – Level 3
Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;

Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;

Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais.
